startUrls.title: Target URLs
startUrls.description: Enter the websites, blog posts, or YouTube video URLs you want to generate visits for.

mode.title: Operation Mode
mode.description: PAGEVIEW: full Playwright browser simulation with JS, DOM execution, dwell time, and human behavior. STRESS_TEST: high-speed concurrent HTTP requests to benchmark server load.

pageviewsPerUrl.title: Visits / Pageviews per URL
pageviewsPerUrl.description: Number of simulated visits to perform for each target URL.

waitOnPage.title: Stay / Dwell Time on Page (seconds)
waitOnPage.description: Number of seconds the browser will remain on each page before completing the session. Essential for lowering bounce rate in Google Analytics / GA4.

enableHumanInteraction.title: Enable Natural Human Interaction
enableHumanInteraction.description: Simulates natural user behavior: progressive smooth scrolling, mouse movements, reading pauses, and click simulation.

enableCrawling.title: Enable Internal Page Crawling
enableCrawling.description: When enabled, the Actor will follow internal hyperlinks found on the target page to simulate multi-page user journeys.

crawlingLinkSelector.title: Crawling Link Selector
crawlingLinkSelector.description: CSS selector to locate internal links when crawling is enabled. Default targets all valid anchor tags.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Maximum Crawl Depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: Maximum number of hops/pages deep the crawler is allowed to navigate from the start URL.

deviceType.title: Device Emulation
deviceType.description: Simulate Desktop or Mobile browsers, or randomize across visits for authentic traffic mix.

customReferrers.title: Custom Traffic Referrers
customReferrers.description: Referrers passed in the request header and DOM to simulate organic search and social traffic sources in web analytics (GA4, Plausible, Cloudflare, etc.).

enableYoutube.title: YouTube Video Watcher Mode
enableYoutube.description: Specialized simulation for YouTube URLs: handles consent modals, triggers video playback, and maintains watch time.

enableAdvancedFingerprinting.title: Stealth & Anti-Detection Fingerprinting
enableAdvancedFingerprinting.description: Uses realistic browser fingerprints, stealth navigator overrides, and blocks WebRTC IP leaks.

blockUrlPatterns.title: Block URL Patterns
blockUrlPatterns.description: Optional list of resource patterns or extensions to block (e.g. '.jpg', '.png', '.mp4') to save proxy bandwidth in stress-testing mode.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel browser sessions or concurrent HTTP requests.

endAfterSeconds.title: Kill Switch / Run Timeout (seconds)
endAfterSeconds.description: Maximum run time in seconds before gracefully shutting down. Set to 0 to let the Actor finish all requested pageviews naturally.

proxy.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy.description: Select Apify Proxy (Residential or Datacenter) or custom proxies for IP rotation and geolocation diversity.
